source.version: main snapshot reviewed 2026-07-13; no tagged release

capabilities.title: Let agents schedule and continue their own work
capabilities.reason: Nexus scheduling remains operator-configured and bounded; imported agents cannot silently create autonomous schedules.

capabilities.title: Coordinate agent work through cmux terminal workflows
capabilities.reason: This external terminal/runtime dependency needs an explicit need and platform review.

capabilities.title: Invoke Codex subagents for bounded work
capabilities.reason: Nexus has bounded specialist delegation; source-specific behavior has not been reviewed or adapted.

capabilities.title: Structure delegation and agent-to-agent handoffs
capabilities.reason: MAX orchestration remains authoritative and duplicate delegation paths are not added during intake.

capabilities.title: Apply a safety-oriented prompt workflow
capabilities.reason: The named skill requires content-level review against current Nexus prompt-security boundaries.

capabilities.title: Run iterative agent work against a goal loop
capabilities.reason: Nexus goal/run lifecycle controls must remain authoritative.

capabilities.title: Create reusable agent handoffs
capabilities.reason: Nexus already has a canonical generated handoff and will not add a competing authority without a selected gap.

capabilities.title: Run a deeper software-engineering agent workflow
capabilities.reason: Commands, providers, and mutation scope require focused review.

capabilities.title: Distribute a skill to multiple agent hosts
capabilities.reason: Nexus does not bulk-write host configuration during source intake.

capabilities.title: Guide effective Agent Skill design
capabilities.reason: Potential overlap with the existing Codex skill-creator must be reviewed first.

capabilities.title: Create folder-specific CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md context
capabilities.reason: Nexus is Codex-first and human-maintained context files cannot be rewritten automatically.

capabilities.title: Publish a skill repository to GitHub
capabilities.reason: GitHub writes remain explicit operator-authorized release actions.

capabilities.title: Use a browser automation harness for web tasks
capabilities.reason: Nexus already has controlled browser/testing paths; upstream commands require review.

capabilities.title: Run a multi-step deep research workflow
capabilities.reason: NOVA/Feynman remain the canonical research systems and no duplicate runtime is added.

capabilities.title: Research and use APIs through a dedicated workflow
capabilities.reason: Every Nexus external API requires protected-route and credential review.

capabilities.title: Research products and online purchases
capabilities.reason: Recommendation and commerce behavior requires live-source, privacy, and affiliate-neutrality review.

capabilities.title: Search the web through a Pi-oriented workflow
capabilities.reason: Provider/tool assumptions have not been reviewed for Nexus.

capabilities.title: Create a structured research prompt
capabilities.reason: Potential overlap with LYRA and NOVA requires focused comparison.

capabilities.title: Retrieve and work with YouTube transcripts
capabilities.reason: Source terms, fetch path, transcript provenance, and retention need review.

capabilities.title: Interview the operator and turn ideas into structured documents
capabilities.reason: Writes to human-owned documents need explicit destination and approval.

capabilities.title: Support level-up and multi-step teaching workflows
capabilities.reason: No selected Nexus learning surface or persistence contract exists for this catalog.

capabilities.title: Prompt the user, create reminders, and produce intentionally concise output
capabilities.reason: These are separate capabilities with existing Nexus/ChatGPT equivalents that need gap selection before adaptation.

capabilities.title: Read architectural decision records before project work
capabilities.reason: Nexus uses scoped file-first context and should not load every ADR indiscriminately.

capabilities.title: Prevent a machine from sleeping during agent work
capabilities.reason: Nexus source intake does not mutate host power behavior or keep machines awake.

capabilities.title: Create a restricted read-only database role
capabilities.reason: Database-specific commands and credentials require a separately authorized target.

capabilities.title: Run cyber-audit and Google Safe Browsing workflows
capabilities.reason: CIPHER boundaries, keys, target authorization, and read-only posture require focused review.

capabilities.title: Install global agent safety guardrails
capabilities.reason: Nexus will not overwrite global host policy from an external catalog during intake.

capabilities.title: Configure Pi custom models and setup assistance
capabilities.reason: All model/provider configuration must remain behind Nexus local/provider policy.

capabilities.title: Manage a VPS through agent instructions
capabilities.reason: External host mutation requires explicit target, credentials, approvals, rollback, and audit evidence.

capabilities.title: Deny dangerous shell patterns through repository hooks and test fixtures
capabilities.reason: The Unix shell hooks are not automatically portable to Windows and must be compared against existing Nexus security gates.
